note: vLLM release installed into /opt/vllm by install.sh: the first release with vllm#58231, the thinking-budget fix with top_p below 1. Wheels ship CUDA 13.0 binaries; the host driver must be 580 or newer.
flashinfer_note: flashinfer-python version pinned by this vLLM release. install.sh installs the matching prebuilt flashinfer-cubin wheel, the flashinfer-jit-cache shim (installed without its dependencies, which are the kernel sets for every GPU architecture) and the sm90a (H100) flashinfer-jit-cache provider package from https://flashinfer.ai/whl/cu130/, so FlashInfer compiles at start-up only what no wheel carries.
